Senses.Explanation: The longest lever the records hold: it stretches from this very turn to the end of all future time, and each speaker spends the whole of it — to deliver beings, to gather in every gift at once, or to rule that even endless speech buys only half a treasury. The sweep across all time: Yongming Yanshou holds that the buddhas, knowing all things natureless, attain all-knowing and a same-body compassion unbroken through the whole of future time, delivering beings; Yuanwu Keqin answers the ask about giving Ganges-sands of bodies in the last watch with one stroke — gathered in at once through the whole of future time; Dahui Zonggao prices his own speech: flap these two skins of lips and the three-inch tongue down to the end of future time, hook-linked and unbroken, and still the whole canon only suits the hearer's capacity with no real meaning; Baiyu Jingsi's verse gives the ancient ones' ways of convenience delivering beings and doing the awakened one's work through all time to come. The limit the sweep exposes: Dahui's old woman — even if mountains, rivers, and every blade of grass each bore a broad long tongue turning from today to the end of future time, on her share it buys only half a treasury; Zhongfeng Mingben bids one pour out a hanging river of wit and lightning-swift spirit, from one sentence to countless sentences, from today to the end of future time, and when words run dry he gently reaches over and pinches the nose; Miyun Yuanwu pairs it — before the King of Sound it was stark bare, through the whole of future time it is stark naked, and right now the cold awe is on each one with no self or other; Hansong Zhicao runs the limitless as one and one as limitless, through all future time again limitless, then rules it still the limited side and throws the ruler-scepter; Dabian Xianquan, two months from his teacher, visits him night and day, tracing back before the King of Sound and straight through to the end of future time with not a seam between; Zhe'an Jingfan raises the vow kings' vow to guard the good friend without bending through all future time, then lifts his staff.
